$comment: Entry schema for contributes.httpCollections (declarative and process plugins). Host validation lives in backend/plugin/contrib_http_collections.go. path references a package-relative .json file under http/ or assets/ in the "mincode.http-collection" version 1 format: {format, version, name, requests[], children[{name, requests, children}], environments[{name, vars[]}]}. Requests have exactly name, method, url, params?, headers?, bodyType?, body?, graphqlQuery?, graphqlVariables? and documentation?; rows are {key, value, description?, enabled?}. There are no auth, form-data, binary or file fields. URLs are absolute http(s) URLs without user:password@ or start with a {{variable}}. Sensitive headers (Authorization, Cookie, X-Api-Key, ...) and any key containing a sensitive fragment must have an empty value or a single {{variable}}; values shaped like credentials (JWTs, private keys, AWS/GitHub/Slack/OpenAI/Google keys, Basic/Bearer values) are rejected. The user imports a copy or opens a request as an unsaved draft; nothing is sent automatically.
description: HTTP request collection templates the user can browse, import as their own collection or open as draft requests.

path.description: Package-relative mincode.http-collection v1 file, for example http/smoke.json (at most 256 KiB).
